claim_boundary: This artifact proves the one-dimensional Huxley--Sargos ledger, joint volume margin, and exact sampled-Mellin target. It proves no sampled-Mellin estimate, low-multiplicity or simple-root closure, complete moment, density, or intervals.

low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.boundary: no sampled-Mellin diagonal bound, low-multiplicity closure, simple-root closure, complete moment, density, or prime intervals is proved
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.generic_loss: a generic time large sieve at sample span HD supplies a term of size HD*L and loses the factor D relative to the desired H*L; removing or inverting these logarithmic aliases is the live lock
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.hs_barrier: the derivative term exceeds the target 1/3 by 4/15-mu/2; it never closes the registered low-multiplicity range
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.hs_sum: order-three Huxley--Sargos in p, summed over q and multiplied by M, has exponents derivative=3/5-mu/2, tube=34/45-mu-xi/3, ratio=5/9-mu-xi/3, constant=1/3
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.lattice_problem: with L=Q/M and delta=D/(KQ), count primitive p,q~L satisfying ||(D/(2pi))log(p/q)||<=delta
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.mellin_identity: a Fejer majorant reduces the joint count to delta L^2 plus delta sum_(1<=h<=H)|sum_(n~L)w(n)n^(ihD)|^2, with H=1/delta=KQ/D
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.mellin_target: the diagonal sampled-Mellin estimate sum_h|P(hD)|^2<<HL X^epsilon implies the optimal label count O(L X^epsilon), hence weighted collision count O(Q X^epsilon)
low_multiplicity_log_saddle_theorem.volume: the joint two-dimensional volume after multiplicity has exponent 14/15-xi-mu, below 1/3 by xi+mu-3/5>=1/25

remaining_target.statement: prove the diagonal sampled-Mellin mean square on a compact lower-band region or extract its logarithmic-major-arc web
